label: Discover run over modal sense-fork nodes: frame strength orders registered, rest triaged
summary: The discovery command truth-discover (24 explicit targets on the modal sense-fork nodes, premise pool all, 10 candidates; main e61946aa1, report 20261120T134013Z) gave 7 kernel-checked discoveries, 2 inconsistent cores and 12 unresolved targets. Registered: the frame-class strength orders S5 > S4, S5 > KTB, S4 > KT and KTB > KT among the route's open frame premises (OnticFrameS5/S4/KTB/KT), each a single-premise result applying the modal library (s5_implies_s4, s5_implies_ktb of TruthCore.Modal.Cube; conjunct projection for S4 > KT and KTB > KT), with one shared strictness control (reflexive non-transitive chain: KT not S4; two-world order frame: KT not KTB, S4 not S5; reflexive symmetric non-transitive path: KTB not S5), and strong_version_needed on the three frame-class branch arguments. Not registered, with reasons: (1) t16 (KTB and S4 frame give S5 frame, proof via symmetric_transitive_implies_euclidean of TruthCore.Modal.Kripke; compiled locally) is deferred for the PR file limit only; with the two S5 registrations it shows that the S5 frame premise says exactly what KTB and S4 say jointly. The corpus records this equivalence only at node level (S5 node iff S4 node and a symmetric frame, and KTB node iff T node and a symmetric frame, specs/strength-necessary-frames.toml), not for the frame premises. (2) t3 and t6: NecessaryPredecessorLifting entails NoNovelNecessarySupport (third conjunct, extra necessity hypothesis unused) and NoContingentGroundOfNecessary (first conjunct). Neither is a transcription, and neither is recorded: only the converse direction lifting_of_two_bridges (with ActualReflexive) exists. Together they show that under actual reflexivity lifting is equivalent to the two bridges. They are strength orders (lifting is the strong version), deferred for the file limit. Strictness outlines, not yet Lean-checked: a necessary target supported at a non-actual world by a contingent source satisfies NoNovel vacuously and fails lifting; two necessary individuals with a support edge only at a non-actual world satisfy NoContingent and fail lifting. (3) t21, t22 (t23 duplicate): any two distinct reading pins IntendedIsBoxT, IntendedIsBoxS4, IntendedIsBoxB, IntendedIsBoxS5 are jointly inconsistent by construction: each fixes Intended to one constructor of the Sense enumeration, so two pins force two distinct constructors to be equal. The exclusion uses no frame class or modal content. It is not recorded as alternative_to, because the pins are coexisting conditional reading choices, each the premise of its own fork route, not rival premises whose refutation is needed (modal-sense-support.toml). (4) t24: NecessaryRootOnIntendedReading entails NecessarySenseUnique. The witness filter of the run is settled: the premise holds in the checked one-point model of MODAL-FORK-CONTROLS (Nonvacuity, Intended = boxT). It is not registered: the node's unique-existence clause yields uniqueness by a short derivation (existential elimination and two equalities); no new content. Every route to the node either takes NecessarySenseUnique as a premise (forkOnIntendedReading, a closed cycle) or takes an IntendedIsBox pin, which gives uniqueness directly, so it adds no discriminating information. Unresolved (no proof found, not refuted): t1 ActualReflexive, t2 Euclidean, t5 WellFoundedPresentEsseSupport, t7 to t11 LogicalNecessityProfiles targets, t13 NecessaryRootBoxS5, t18 to t20 the T, 5 and B schema validity premises. t4 and t12 were filtered as domain_by_name (identification across modules by name only). Follow-up (same date): the four frame registrations now carry certified differences (#1598) as strength_comparison records with exact equivalence certificates on the same route frame: S5 iff S4 and symmetric (frameS5OverS4Exact), S5 iff KTB and transitive (frameS5OverKTBExact), S4 iff KT and transitive (frameS4OverKTExact), KTB iff KT and symmetric (frameKTBOverKTExact); deltas OnticFrameSymmetric and OnticFrameTransitive in TruthCore.Causality.ModalSenseSupport. The S4/KT and KTB/KT certificates hold by conjunct regrouping. No separator settings were recorded: a separator must be a theorem of type Separation of a closed setting, so the existing FrameStrictness control (a four-part conjunction) cannot serve directly; strictness stays recorded on the strengthens registrations. t16 is registered as the two-premise result frameS5OfKTBAndS4 (KTB frame and S4 frame give S5 frame); not a transcription, since the Euclidean conjunct is derived by the proved library lemma symmetric_transitive_implies_euclidean. t3/t6 remain deferred for the PR file limit; their strictness countermodels were compiled axiom-free in a scratch file, not committed: (a) worlds and beings Bool, universal frame, true exists everywhere, false only at world true, support edge false to true only at world true, actual world false: NoNovelNecessarySupport holds vacuously (no necessary source has an edge) and lifting fails (the contingent source of a necessary target); (b) same frame, both beings everywhere, same edge: NoContingentGroundOfNecessary holds and lifting fails (the edge is absent at the actual world).
blocker: Next tests: register NecessaryPredecessorLifting strengthens NoNovelNecessarySupport and strengthens NoContingentGroundOfNecessary (forward proofs: third and first conjunct of lifting; strictness: the two Bool countermodels above), with certified differences if a non-degenerate delta is found (under ActualReflexive, lifting_of_two_bridges suggests each bridge's delta is the other bridge, but that needs ActualReflexive as background and must be checked against the no-background rule), and strong_version_needed on the arguments that use lifting (NECESSARY-PREDECESSOR-LIFT-FROM-BRIDGES excluded; NECESSARY-UNDERIVED-POSITIVE-LIFT, NECESSARY-UNDERIVED-NONREFUTATION-LIFT, 78dfeded). Optionally add Separation settings for the four frame comparisons (two-world order frame, chain, path). Attempt the frame-to-schema bridges (t18 to t20). Every frame premise stays open.
